Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime (Windows)
Copyright Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.

Nodex distributes unmodified retail Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs app-locally
when required by a bundled third-party binary. These files are copied from the
matching architecture's Visual Studio MSVC redistributable directory on the
Windows build host. Microsoft signatures are retained. They are licensed
separately from Nodex and its open-source dependencies under Microsoft's
applicable software license and developer redistribution terms. The runtime
license alone does not grant redistribution rights.

Runtime terms:
https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/vs2022-cruntime/
https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/vs2026-ga-visualcpp-v14-redist-runtime/
Redistribution terms and permitted files:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/releases/2026/redistribution
Deployment guidance:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files

Only retail redistributables are included, never debug runtimes. Nodex delivers
security updates for these app-local components through application updates.
